title: Wake Up to the Responsibility of Your Divine Servanthood!
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) laa ilaaha illa-Llah,, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadur
Rasoolullah `alayhi salaatullah, `alayhi salaamullah, wa `ala saairi 'l-anbiyaa wa 'l-mursaleen, wa aalin kulli
ajma`een, wa `anni 't-tabi'eena lahum, wa salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadAllahi 's-saaliheen. (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)
Dastoor. Thumma as-salaamu `alayk yaa Saahib az-Zamaan, thumma as-salaamu `alayk yaa Qutb alZamaan, thumma as-salaamu `alayk yaa Qutb al-Mutassarrif, thumma as-salaamu `alaykum yaa as-haab alnawbah min ahli 's-samawaati wa 'l-araadeen. Allahumma rawid `abdik fee ridaak. yaa Rabbee.
The holy command of The Lord of Heavens is, “Leave Shaytan and come to Me!” And we are saying, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. That means we are leaving Shaytan and saying, "O our Lord! Keep
Shaytan away." And we are saying (Mawlana Shaykh stands), Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, Bismillahi
'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits).
O our Attenders! Welcome to you! If you are attending you are gaining, and if you are not attending you are
losing. Whoever wants to reach heavenly treasures, come and ask! If you are not interested in heavenly
treasures, it may be that you are going to die and become fertilizer. Not just one, but there must be billions

who must hear, must listen, and must obey! If you are saying you are servants, then you must hear the
heavenly news, and you must listen and try to take a share from that heavenly address. Come and obey! We
must obey and we must try to be obedient servants. You can't find any better honor for yourself than to be an
obedient servant. When the Lord of Heavens is happy with you, He is dressing that honored dressing upon
you. Expensive dresses are for dunya people, whose aim is only dunya. When you pass away they take these
dresses, put a white cloth and say, "Enough, more than enough!"
O our Attenders! Are you understanding? If you are not understanding, something from heavenly warnings
may reach you. You may wake up with pains in your stomach, your head, in your lower or upper sides, if you
are not understanding. They are coming to you, and you wake up and shout, "Where are the tablets to stop
this pain?" Useless! If there is no order from heavenly ones to give you a benefit, then even if you are taking a
handful of tablets it is impossible to stop that pain!
O People! Use your minds. They are not making me to sit here to make a theater (performance) for you, no!
We are sitting here for understanding, and to follow what we are understanding. So many times they are
making such a weak servant to wake you up. Wake up!
O Salafi `ulamas! You are giving yourselves a special title that is not true. You must try to wake people up;
that is your mission, nothing else! This is a holy order from the Lord of Heavens, "O My prophets! Make My
servants wake up. Give them such advice that they will wake up before pains come to them, waking them!"
There are two kinds of waking up. One kind of waking up is for your heavenly servanthood and the second
kind of waking up comes to people when they are waking up with heavy pains, with such bad conditions for
themselves or their families, their children, and they are not going to taste any good taste. When they are
sleeping, they are awakened, as some reason is giving trouble to you.
O People, try to wake up for your servanthood; nothing is more important, without exception! If you do what
is obligatory for you, then you may put your head down to sleep, and the angels will say, "Sleep well." Angels
are waiting for you, keeping Shaytan away from touching you. They say, "Sleep happily, sleep with
enjoyment, sleep with pleasure." Up to the time of heavenly service, to midnight and after it, leaving you to
sleep so smoothly, as small babies are sleeping, but only if you hear and obey!
O Salafi `ulamas! Teach people how they must sleep. They answer, "We are `ulamas, so important! We do

not occupy ourselves with how Mankind sleeps!" How? (Mawlana Shaykh stands) The Seal of Prophets (s)
said, Ad-deenu naseeha, "Religion is advice." (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Naseeha, advice, is for the benefit of
Mankind. O Salafi `ulamas! You must say how they should sleep: silently, happily, and in satisfaction? Why
are you not saying? "No, we are saying ahadeeth ash-shareefah, so many of them coming from books, one
after the other. But we are not doing this everyday." No! Wa dhakkir, and remind them! This means you must
at every moment try to wake servants up, to keep them from falling into wells of troubles.
O People! As-salaamu 'alaykum. Don't be angry; what is being said is first for me and then for you! Say, Salafi
`ulamas, how was the life of the Seal of Prophets (s) and what is Allah Almighty saying? (Mawlana Shaykh
stands)

laqad kaana lakum fee rasoolullahi uswatun hasanatun liman kaana yarjoo allaha wa 'l-yawma 'l-'akhira wa
dhakara allaha katheera. Indeed in the Messenger of Allah you have an excellent example, for who hopes in
(the Meeting with) Allah and the Last Day, and remembers Allah often. (al-Ahzab, 33:21)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Is that an ayatu 'l-kareemah, a holy verse or not? Why aren't you calling people to
follow Rasoolullah (s), making him a best symbol for the life of people? Why was Allah Almighty saying this,
wa lakum fee rasoolullahi uswatun hasanat? Who are those for whom the Lord of Heavens was saying,
lakum, “for you”? O People, "for you!" As long as Mankind is living on this planet, they should be addressed
through that holy verse, as that gives a model for all Mankind. Don't say, "We are high life people who follow
western models and 21st century fashions for everything." Leave that and follow this!
O Salafi `ulamas! Why are you not saying to your mulook, who are giving money to you? Why are you not
waking them up? Where was the Seal of Prophets (s) living? What was he sleeping on? He was sleeping on a
hasir, straw mat, taking such a peaceful, enjoyful sleep. You are sleeping on first-class fashion beds with
beautiful ladies, but you can't reach what the Seal of Prophets (s) reached. Why is Allah Almighty saying, wa
lakum fee rasoolullahi uswatun hasanat? To what does this apply? Say, for everything! You must follow him,
you must use him as the model for your lives! When you say, "The life of the Seal of Prophets (s) is the model
and we are following him," then you may reach satisfaction; nothing will touch you or give you trouble! Then

we may sleep with full pleasement, in peace. Angels will say to you, "As-salaamu `alaykum, O followers of the
Seal of Prophets (s)! Peace be upon you and sleep well, and wake up with full satisfaction and full pleasure."
Your physical body will take its rights and become so happy, and will make sajdah for Allah Almighty and say,
"Allahu Akbar!"
That is Allah's grant to us. Why are you not following? Ad-deenu naseeha, religion is good advice! Why are
you not giving that advice to Muslims? This holy verse is enough for you to be in pleasure for your entire life,
in honor and peace! Why are you not teaching this to people? Allah Almighty is going to ask `ulamas, Hal
balaghat, "Did you convey the message?" The Lord of Heavens will ask of anbiyaa, prophets. Allah Almighty
will say to Sayyidina 'Isa (a), (Mawlana Shaykh stands)

wa 'idh qaala allaahu yaa `eesá 'bna maryama a'anta qulta li '-naasi attakhidhoonee wa ummiya ilahayni min
doonillahi qaala sub•aanaka maa yakoonu lee an aqoola maa laysa lee bi•aqqin in kuntu qultuhu faqad
`alimtahu ta`lamu maa fee nafsee wa laa a`lamu maa fee nafsika innaka anta `allaamu al-ghuyoob. And
(remember) when Allah will say (on the Day of Resurrection), "O 'Isa, son of Maryam! Did you say to men,
'Worship me and my mother as two gods besides Allah?'" He will say,"Glory be to You! It was not for me to
say what I had no right. Had I said such a thing, You would surely have known it. You know what is in my
inner -self, though I do not know what is in Yours! Truly only You are the Knower of all that is Hidden and
Unseen. (Al-Ma'idah 5:116)
A'anta qulta li 'n-naasi attakhidhoonee wa ummiya ilahayni min doonillah, "Did you say to people to take
yourself and your mother as gods other than Allah?" (Mawlana Shaykh sits) 'a'anta qulta, from the weight of
`azhamat, the glory of this address, Jesus Christ (a) is going to disappear, (Mawlana Shaykh bows his head)
and say, "O my Lord! You know what I said to them!" If the anbiyaa are going to be asked in such a way, then
what about you, who say, "We are Salafi `ulamas." Angels are asking why are you not waking the servants of
Allah Almighty for His heavenly servanthood? Allah Almighty will ask, "Why are you not teaching how they
should live, and which one should be a model for the life of Mankind? Why are you not making it clear?"

I am asking the al-Azhar `ulamas also. Some of them are such no-mind people, there is a fitnah, corruption,
in Farengistan, France. It is Shaytan's place, where they are making a qanoon, law, that a Muslim woman
must not cover her face. What is that? And some al-Azhar `ulamas are saying that is correct! How are they
going to answer on the Day of Resurrection, saying that law and order of the French government is true! How
are they saying that this shaytanic fatwah is true? (...) Therefore, that one who claims he is a big `alim is
making a big mistake and he is jaahil, ignorant. Allah Almighty will punish him, as He is closing the baab alfitnah, the door of corruption. Shame on who is supporting the French government; they are not Muslim
people. Non-Muslim people may not put their law against Muslim law. I am sorry to say that, because I am
very angry. If he does not apologize, heavenly law will throw a heavenly lightning on his head and he will not
live longer. May Allah forgive us.
O People! No one can change Shari`atullah, holy laws and orders of Allah Almighty! Yaa Rabb, O our Lord,
forgive us! Send us one who can teach real Islam to Your servants. Where are you (what is your position),
Salafi `ulamas, and why are you not refusing and objecting on what that ‘alim, that doctor is saying? If you
are not refusing his fatwah, then you are going to be shareeki-jurum, partners in this crime, and you will
share the penalty for it.
Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah. Allah, Allah! Forgive us, yaa Rabbee! Send
us someone to correct everything. The people who have destroyed your Shari`ah may be taken away, and
those who keep the Shari`atullah may come for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammed (s)!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
